name: @firedmosquito831/my-claude-code
description: My Claude Code (MCC): a local multi-provider LLM proxy, model router and control plane for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI and other AI coding agents, with 57 providers, fallback routing, credential health, a native web-search tool proxy, and analytics with cost provenance. This npm package installs and launches the Python server.
